# Test pieces to exclude from all training data (PDMX, ASAP, GrandStaff, Lieder, Scriabin kern)
# before the next training run. One line per piece: composer | work | catalog | test name.
# Exclude the whole work where a line names a movement of a multi-movement work only if the
# training source stores the work as one file; otherwise the named movement is enough.
# Sources: run/out/testset/ (real-scan test set), run/eval_run1/pages/ and
# run/box_scripts/extra_sources.md (old test pieces), the fork's
# training/omr_datasets/pdmx_exclude_test_pieces.txt (bracket test set). Do not edit that file from here.
